title: Native RAW loader narrows an unchecked payload length before validating it
description:
The RAW truncation guard multiplies uint32 dimensions in size_t and casts the unchecked payload to long. On64bit RGB48 width=height0x80000000 yields modular payload2^63, which narrows negative and lets a header-only input pass; the later mono allocation can terminate the service. Direct CLI and IMAGE BLOB reachability are source-confirmed, and preview rejection does not gate the backend. Validate signed-representable geometry and nonoverflowing input/output extents before conversion/allocation, preferably reusing the common RAW validator and solver limits. Safe arithmetic-only proof; no unsafe allocation, image solve or arbitrary-code-execution claim. Fixed and reverified by the linked repair task; source and runtime limits remain recorded there.
